body:
Good idea! This makes sense to me.

I guess in C++20 it would be possible to use `no_unique_address`, but I can't think of a reason this would be any better than `EBO` anyway.
Edit: I guess one caveat would be that this won't work for `final` allocators, but it doesn't seem like we use `final`, and I don't see a reason to use it either (and if we do find one, we can reconsider).
